name: AppUi::Pager
description: The range text (1-20 / 20+) and the previous and next buttons of a paged list. It only shows where the list is and reports the offset of the page asked for.

offset.description: The offset of the first row shown

count.description: The rows shown on this page; the range ends there on the last page

hasMore.description: Whether rows exist after this page; Gaia sends no totals

total.description: The record count, when the caller has one; then the range reads it and next follows it

disabled.description: Disables both buttons, e.g. while the next page loads

payload.name: offset
payload.description: The offset of the first row of the page asked for

variants.name: without a total
variants.description: Gaia lists: the range reads 20+ while more rows exist

variants.name: disabled
variants.description: Both buttons off while the next page loads
